fields.title: Your activity in a few words
fields.titleHint: Up to 120 characters. Add this title before publishing.
fields.bioHint: Your background, approach and what you want to contribute. Up to 1,600 characters.
fields.skillsHint: Up to 12 declared skills, each up to 60 characters.
fields.languageHint: Up to 6 languages. For another language, enter its code, such as pt or fr-GA.
fields.zoneHint: A city or broad area; avoid publishing your home address.
fields.collaborationTypes: Collaboration types you are looking for
fields.visibilityHint: The network is the initial choice. An unlisted link stays restricted to admitted members. Public access requires separate consent.

consent.public: I agree to make my profile publicly accessible, with only the information selected above.

editor.title: My professional profile
editor.lead: Prepare your profile, then choose when to publish it. Saving changes to a published profile returns it to draft until you publish again.

editor.moderation: Publication remains subject to network rules and moderation.
editor.publishedEdit: Saving changes will temporarily remove this published profile. You can publish it again after review.

directory.skillsHint: Up to 6 skills, separated by commas.
